Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, asymmetric facial markings, colors, clothing, accessories and long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: The asymmetric royal BLUE Sproto in the reference. Tall jagged blue tufts at back and sides. Small jagged GOLD/YELLOW crown with BLACK round ornaments along the top, attached to head. A large round YELLOW coin-like monocle/disc covers the near eye, decorated with several BLACK round speckles and white glints exactly like reference; preserve its little rim and side attachment. The other eye is a sleepy asymmetric layered YELLOW shape crossed by a long BLUE lid, with BLACK pupil marks as in reference. Small BLACK rounded nose; huge broad RED closed smiling lips and PURPLE lower jaw enclosed by a bright YELLOW curved jaw rim. Blue bare slender arms/hands, thick segmented YELLOW waist belt, red cloth at lower waist. Extend BLUE legs and simple red boots. Preserve the strange asymmetric facial markings, never replace them with generic matching eyes. No boxing gloves, cape, staff or handheld prop. Reference image 2 is the reviewed combat sheet; match its proportions and style.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. Preserve the same costume and face across every frame. Same-hue limited palette shading; no white clothing patches, text, floating effects, detached accessories or additional actors.

Exactly 32 separate complete drawings, regular 4-column by 8-row grid, read left-to-right/top-to-bottom. All 32 are the SAME single actor, including lying floor drawings. No opponents or partner drawn.
Row 1 INTRO:stand with blue hands on hips and sly asymmetric gaze; lean head forward and tip the attached gold crown with two blue fingertips; straighten the crown and lift chin proudly, other hand still on hip; release crown and settle into cocky guard. Crown and monocle remain attached, no detached objects.
Row 2 SPECIAL A: low coil; shoulder windup; fully extended straight impact punch; punch retract.
Row 3 SPECIAL B: alternate shoulder strike; retract to cover; two-arm finishing palm thrust to RIGHT; recover combat guard. No floating effects.
Row 4 CAST:purse the broad red lips under the yellow coin monocle, tilt crowned head back and puff cheeks; low knees coil while arms tuck behind torso; explosive open-mouth SPIT to RIGHT with crowned head thrust forward and broad lips stretched, both hands back away from the face; recover sly closed red smile and straighten posture. No palm shot, projectile or effects drawn.
Row 5 RECOIL: chest impact arch; head/torso lean back with arms still connected; bend knees to absorb; regain combat guard.
Row 6 to 8: DEFEAT START: sleepy eye opens in shock while one hand steadies attached crown; stagger with knees folding and crown tilted but still attached; collapse seated while both hands protect crown and monocle; roll onto side with head LEFT and feet RIGHT, all ornaments attached. DEFEAT FLOOR: fully side-lying body with one hand still touching the crown; elbow sinks to floor; hand slides beside face while monocle remains fixed; settle side-lying with crown clearly visible. DEFEAT REST: broad red mouth slackens; near hand opens; one tiny final shoulder drop; still side-lying rest, crown never floats or becomes a separate character. Exactly four figures per row, twelve defeat drawings total. Preserve the same costume and face across every frame. Same-hue limited palette shading; no white clothing patches, text, floating effects, detached accessories or additional actors.
